$comment: The BASE READING step of the layered extraction: seven printed fields, plus four scratchpad fields that come FIRST in the object on purpose. Earlier design used a two-stage <analisis>/<json> tag split, but that is incompatible with grammar-constrained decoding (Ollama's `format` param compiles this schema to a GBNF grammar; the model's entire output must satisfy it, so nothing can appear outside the object). Moving the scratchpad INSIDE the schema keeps the same benefit — the model reasons about emitter vs. recipient before it commits to cuit_emisor/razon_social_emisor — while staying 100% valid structured output. Grammar-constrained generation emits properties in the order declared here, so the analysis fields are genuinely produced before the final ones, not after. The other four scopes are RESERVED artifacts (`detection`, `desglose`, `rubro`, `clasificacion`). The two fields that asked *is this a receipt* live in `invoice_detection.json`, not here. It carries no critical-severity field on purpose — `importe_total_facturado` moved to the step that holds the arithmetic combination that confirms it.

analisis_pares_clave_valor.description: terse list of raw label:value pairs found in the text, separated by ';' (e.g. 'CUIT: 20-...; Fecha: 07/08/2026; Comp.Nro.: 00037469'). Uncorrected, unfiltered — a sweep, not a judgement

analisis_emisor.description: terse summary of the EMITTER block only (usually the header, above 'Cliente:'): name and CUIT as they appear there. This is the ONLY source for razon_social_emisor and cuit_emisor below

analisis_receptor.description: terse summary of the RECIPIENT/'Cliente:' block: name and CUIT. Stated explicitly so it is never confused with analisis_emisor below

analisis_totales.description: terse summary of the totals/balance block: subtotal, IVA, total, any 'Saldo Cta Cte' line. Note which line (if any) is a genuine printed observation versus a running-account balance that does not belong in notas

tipo_comprobante.description: the letter or the AFIP code printed in the header (001 Factura A, 006 Factura B, 011 Factura C), or 'null' when the document is not a fiscal receipt. 090/099 are 'comprobantes que no cumplen la RG 1415', not receipt classes

razon_social_emisor.description: the EMITTER's name as printed in the header, without labels like 'Razon Social:' or 'Cliente:'. Taken from analisis_emisor above, re-checked against the source text — never the recipient's

cuit_emisor.description: the EMITTER's CUIT, digits and its own hyphens only, format XX-XXXXXXXX-X. Taken from analisis_emisor above, re-checked against the source text — never the recipient's. Cut the value at the first character that is not a digit or a hyphen, even if it is left incomplete

fecha_emision.description: the issue date as printed, DD/MM/YYYY. The issue date, not the due date and not the billing period

nro_comprobante.description: the receipt number printed beside 'Comp.Nro.' or 'Nro.', complete, with the hyphen if it has one. Not the point of sale, not the CAE, not an item code, not the tipo_comprobante code

moneda.description: the currency the document shows; 'ARS' when it shows none

notas.description: real observations printed on the receipt, or 'null'. Not a column header, not a running-account balance, not a summary of what you did, and not text in another language
